title: Game with Strings
statementMd:
You play the game with your friend. The description of this game is listed below.

Your friend creates $*n*$ distinct strings of the same length $*m*$ and tells you all the strings. Then he randomly chooses one of them. He chooses strings equiprobably, i.e. the probability of choosing each of the $*n*$ strings equals ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/68d6f939906e1ed93f58f66830326d540298fdfa.png). You want to guess which string was chosen by your friend.

In order to guess what string your friend has chosen, you are allowed to ask him questions. Each question has the following form: «What character stands on position $*pos*$ in the string you have chosen?» A string is considered guessed when the answers to the given questions uniquely identify the string. After the string is guessed, you stop asking questions.

You do not have a particular strategy, so as each question you equiprobably ask about a position that hasn't been yet mentioned. Your task is to determine the expected number of questions needed to guess the string chosen by your friend.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 50$) — the number of strings your friend came up with.

The next $*n*$ lines contain the strings that your friend has created. It is guaranteed that all the strings are distinct and only consist of large and small English letters. Besides, the lengths of all strings are the same and are between $1$ to $20$ inclusive.

## Output

Print the single number — the expected value. Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error doesn't exceed $10^{ - 9}$.

## Note

In the first sample the strings only differ in the character in the third position. So only the following situations are possible:

- you guess the string in one question. The event's probability is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/adaad783a304f9e72218e6e79114c6551a112aad.png);
- you guess the string in two questions. The event's probability is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/caddcdaf0d707d9e4ffa41e63e462a3c90474546.png) $·$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6bb1686dc4a3e6a10e00b92d434455668cb330a8.png) = ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/adaad783a304f9e72218e6e79114c6551a112aad.png) (as in this case the first question should ask about the position that is other than the third one);
- you guess the string in three questions. The event's probability is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/caddcdaf0d707d9e4ffa41e63e462a3c90474546.png) $·$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6bb1686dc4a3e6a10e00b92d434455668cb330a8.png) $·$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a53d50910d43b79b6602f97f9fde950c9d1bdf77.png) = ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/adaad783a304f9e72218e6e79114c6551a112aad.png);

Thus, the expected value is equal to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5f789afab0601bacf9123c73584184ef358740fb.png)

In the second sample we need at most two questions as any pair of questions uniquely identifies the string. So the expected number of questions is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/208df5d4b6316ba263eede5d4cf4b844075718f1.png).

In the third sample whatever position we ask about in the first question, we immediately identify the string.
statementZhMd:
<statement>
你和你的朋友玩一个游戏。游戏规则如下。

你的朋友创建 $*n*$ 个长度相同且互不相同的字符串，并把所有字符串都告诉你。然后，他会从中随机选择一个字符串。他等概率地选择字符串，即选择每个字符串的概率均为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/68d6f939906e1ed93f58f66830326d540298fdfa.png)。你需要猜出你的朋友选择了哪个字符串。

为了猜出朋友选择的字符串，你可以向他提问。每个问题的形式如下：「你选择的字符串在位置 $*pos*$ 上是什么字符？」当所提问题的答案能够唯一确定一个字符串时，就认为你猜出了该字符串。猜出字符串后，你就不再提问。

你没有特定的策略，因此每次提问时，都会等概率地询问一个尚未被询问过的位置。你的任务是确定猜出朋友所选字符串所需问题数的期望值。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 50$）——你的朋友创建的字符串数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行包含你的朋友创建的字符串。保证所有字符串互不相同，且只由大小写英文字母组成。此外，所有字符串的长度相同，且在 $1$ 到 $20$（含）之间。

## 输出格式

输出一个数——期望值。如果你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 9}$，则会被认为是正确的。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，字符串仅在第三个位置的字符上有所不同。因此，只有以下几种情况可能发生：

- 你在一次提问后猜出字符串。该事件的概率为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/adaad783a304f9e72218e6e79114c6551a112aad.png)；
- 你在两次提问后猜出字符串。该事件的概率为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/caddcdaf0d707d9e4ffa41e63e462a3c90474546.png) $·$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6bb1686dc4a3e6a10e00b92d434455668cb330a8.png) = ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/adaad783a304f9e72218e6e79114c6551a112aad.png)（因为此时第一次提问必须询问第三个位置以外的位置）；
- 你在三次提问后猜出字符串。该事件的概率为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/caddcdaf0d707d9e4ffa41e63e462a3c90474546.png) $·$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6bb1686dc4a3e6a10e00b92d434455668cb330a8.png) $·$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a53d50910d43b79b6602f97f9fde950c9d1bdf77.png) = ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/adaad783a304f9e72218e6e79114c6551a112aad.png)；

因此，期望值等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5f789afab0601bacf9123c73584184ef358740fb.png)

在第二个样例中，最多需要提问两次，因为任意两个问题都能唯一确定字符串。因此，提问次数的期望值为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/208df5d4b6316ba263eede5d4cf4b844075718f1.png)。

在第三个样例中，无论第一次询问哪个位置，都能立即确定字符串。
</statement>
